ds3.speaker: Opening narration
ds3.text: The fire fades, and the lords go without thrones.

ds3.speaker: Opening narration
ds3.text:
When the link of fire is threatened, the bell tolls,
unearthing the old Lords of Cinder from their graves.

ds3.speaker: Opening narration
ds3.text:
Yes, indeed. It is called Lothric,
Where the transitory lands of the Lords of Cinder converge.

ds3.speaker: Fire Keeper
ds3.text:
Welcome to the bonfire, Unkindled One.
I am a Fire Keeper.
I tend to the flame, and tend to thee.

ds3.speaker: Fire Keeper
ds3.text: Ashen one, hearest thou my voice, still?

ds3.speaker: Father Ariandel
ds3.text: When the Ashes are two, a flame alighteth. Thou'rt Ash, and fire befits thee, of course...

ds3.speaker: Fire Keeper
ds3.text: Ashen one, to be Unkindled is to be a vessel for souls.

ds3.speaker: Fire Keeper
ds3.text: Sovereignless souls will become thy strength.

ds3.speaker: Fire Keeper
ds3.text: Farewell, ashen one. Mayst thou thy peace discov'r.

ds3.speaker: Siegward of Catarina
ds3.text: To be honest, I'm in a bit of a pickle.

ds3.speaker: Siegward of Catarina
ds3.text: I've got to use my head. And think.

ds3.speaker: Siegward of Catarina
ds3.text:
To your valour, my sword, and our victory together.
Long may the Sun shine!

ds3.speaker: Siegward of Catarina
ds3.text: Not to worry. Great planning begets great fortune.

ds3.speaker: Siegward of Catarina
ds3.text: Even we Undead deserve a little normalcy, from time to time.

ds3.speaker: Siegward of Catarina
ds3.text:
Yhorm, old friend.
I, Siegward of the Knights of Catarina, have come to uphold my promise!
Let the sun shine upon this Lord of Cinder.

ds3.speaker: Hawkwood
ds3.text: Well, you're not alone. We Unkindled are worthless. Can't even die right. Gives me conniptions.

ds3.speaker: Hawkwood
ds3.text: The poor wretched souls... Be they lord or legend, the curse shows no mercy. What a shame.

ds3.speaker: Hawkwood
ds3.text: And they made him a Lord of Cinder. Not for virtue, but for might.

ds3.speaker: Hawkwood
ds3.text: Even accursed Undead want to believe they're special, it seems.

ds3.speaker: Hawkwood
ds3.text: You are a dragon, more dragon than I.

ds3.speaker: Blacksmith Andre
ds3.text: Let me smith y' weapons. I am a smith, such is my purpose.

ds3.speaker: Blacksmith Andre
ds3.text: In battle, y' weapons are yer only friends. Forge them well, and they won't let y' down.

ds3.speaker: Blacksmith Andre
ds3.text: A cursed fate this may be, but hope remains, does it not?

ds3.speaker: Blacksmith Andre
ds3.text: Overstep not your bounds, cousin. I may serve, but I'm no slave. I have business I must attend, begone.

ds3.speaker: Sir Vilhelm
ds3.text: Every fleeing man must be caught. Every secret must be unearthed.

ds3.speaker: Sir Vilhelm
ds3.text: Such is the conceit of the self-proclaimed seeker of truth.

ds3.speaker: Sir Vilhelm
ds3.text: Stray from the withering flame, and the snow will swallow you whole.

ds3.speaker: Sir Vilhelm
ds3.text: No bell tolls, and yet, you've slipped into the painting?

ds3.speaker: Sister Friede
ds3.text:
Leave us be, Ashen One.
Sweep all thought of us from thy mind. As thy kind always have.

ds3.speaker: Opening narration
ds3.text: That ash seeketh embers.

bb.speaker: Master Willem
bb.text: ...We are born of the blood, made men by the blood, undone by the blood. Our eyes are yet to open...

bb.speaker: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
bb.text: A hunter is a hunter, even in a dream.

bb.speaker: Gehrman
bb.text: Tonight, Gehrman joins the hunt...

bb.speaker: Gehrman
bb.text: The night, and the dream, were long...

bb.speaker: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
bb.text: As you once did for the vacuous Rom, grant us eyes, grant us eyes. Plant eyes on our brains, to cleanse our beastly idiocy.

bb.speaker: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
bb.text: Ahh, Kos, or some say Kosm... Do you hear our prayers?

bb.speaker: The Doll
bb.text: Hello, good hunter. I am a doll, here in this dream to look after you.

bb.speaker: Ludwig, The Holy Blade
bb.text:
Aah, you were at my side, all along.
My true mentor...
My guiding moonlight...

bb.speaker: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower
bb.text: A corpse... should be left well alone.

bb.speaker: Master Willem
bb.text: By the gods, fear it, Laurence.

bb.speaker: Master Willem
bb.text: Oh, I know, I know. You think now, to betray me.

bb.speaker: Laurence
bb.text: No, but you will never listen. I tell you, I will not forget our adage.

bb.speaker: The Doll
bb.text: Welcome home, good hunter. What is it you desire?

bb.speaker: The Doll
bb.text: Farewell, good hunter. May you find your worth in the waking world.

bb.speaker: The Doll
bb.text: Good hunter... Your presence somehow soothes... I sense the ancient echoes, they course your veins...

bb.speaker: Gehrman
bb.text: The moon is close. It will be a long hunt tonight.

bb.speaker: Gehrman
bb.text: Just go out and kill a few beasts. It's for your own good. You know, it's just what hunters do!

bb.speaker: Gehrman
bb.text: Farewell, my keen hunter. Fear the blood.

bb.speaker: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
bb.text: No, we shall not abandon the dream.

bb.speaker: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
bb.text: The cosmos, of course!

bb.speaker: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
bb.text: New ideas, of the higher plane!

bb.speaker: Ludwig, The Holy Blade
bb.text: Good hunter, have you seen the thread of light?

bb.speaker: Ludwig, The Holy Blade
bb.text: Thank you kindly. Now I may sleep in peace.

bb.speaker: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower
bb.text: Oh, I know very well. How the secrets beckon so sweetly.

bb.speaker: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower
bb.text: Only an honest death will cure you now.

bb.speaker: Eileen the Crow
bb.text: Without fear in our hearts, we're little different from the beasts themselves.

bb.speaker: Eileen the Crow
bb.text: What are you still doing here? Enough trembling in your boots. A hunter must hunt.

bb.speaker: Eileen the Crow
bb.text: This too is hunters' work, but bears no honor. A burden you may choose to carry.

bb.speaker: Eileen the Crow
bb.text: Few hunters can resist the intoxication of the hunt. Look at you, just the same as all the rest...

bb.speaker: Father Gascoigne
bb.text: ...Beasts all over the shop... You'll be one of them, sooner or later...

bb.speaker: Father Gascoigne
bb.text: What's that smell? ... The sweet blood, oh, it sings to me. It's enough to make a man sick

bb.speaker: Djura
bb.text: The things you hunt, they're not beasts. They're people.

bb.speaker: Djura
bb.text: You have the whole night to dream. Make the best of it.

bb.speaker: Djura
bb.text: There's nothing more horrific than a hunt. In case you've failed to realize...

bb.speaker: Djura
bb.text: Is it the blood, or are you just raving mad?

sekiro.speaker: Isshin, the Sword Saint
sekiro.text: Hesitation is defeat.

sekiro.speaker: Owl
sekiro.text: There is no shame in losing one battle. But you must take revenge by any means necessary!

sekiro.speaker: Kuro
sekiro.text: How many times have you died and come back to life for my sake...?

sekiro.speaker: Wolf
sekiro.text: A code must be determined by the individual... This is what I've decided.

sekiro.speaker: Isshin, the Sword Saint
sekiro.text: How my blood boils! Face me, Sekiro!

sekiro.speaker: Isshin, the Sword Saint
sekiro.text: Come... Sekiro.

sekiro.speaker: Genichiro
sekiro.text: I will restore Ashina to glory!

sekiro.speaker: Genichiro
sekiro.text: I will not allow Ashina to be crushed...!

sekiro.speaker: Genichiro
sekiro.text: I too have a duty I must uphold... Farewell.

sekiro.speaker: Genichiro
sekiro.text: We are not so different, you and I...Wolf.

sekiro.speaker: Owl
sekiro.text: Been a while since we did this. Give me your all!

sekiro.speaker: Owl
sekiro.text: It warms my heart, Wolf! To see how you've grown!

sekiro.speaker: Owl
sekiro.text: No more than a stray dog after all.

sekiro.speaker: Wolf
sekiro.text: Death of a shadow... You taught me well.

sekiro.speaker: Wolf
sekiro.text: As it was for the purpose of defending my Lord, the number does not matter.

sekiro.speaker: Wolf
sekiro.text: My lord's oath is all I need.

sekiro.speaker: Kuro
sekiro.text: I do not wish to bind you... to an eternity of undeath.

sekiro.speaker: Kuro
sekiro.text: Wolf... Rice tastes a lot better when cooked.

sekiro.speaker: Kuro
sekiro.text: The sword that can kill those who cannot die...

sekiro.speaker: Lady Butterfly
sekiro.text: Now then, son of Owl. Shall we dance?

sekiro.speaker: Kuro
sekiro.text: Loyal Wolf, take my blood and live again.

sekiro.speaker: Emma
sekiro.text: It's just...I would want to kill a demon if one were to appear.

sekiro.speaker: Emma
sekiro.text: As a doctor, I do have other uses for sake beyond just drinking.

sekiro.speaker: Emma
sekiro.text: He was a very kind monkey.

sekiro.speaker: The Sculptor
sekiro.text: Looks like death is not your fate just yet.

sekiro.speaker: The Sculptor
sekiro.text: Your death won't come easily.

sekiro.speaker: The Sculptor
sekiro.text: In other words, that prosthetic arm... is Dogen's legacy.

sekiro.speaker: Isshin Ashina
sekiro.text: Those who go on killing will eventually become Shura.

sekiro.speaker: Isshin Ashina
sekiro.text: There aren't many masters of the sword like her. To see her fight, it's like she is dancing.

sekiro.speaker: Isshin Ashina
sekiro.text: I've lived a long life, but that was the closest I've come to death.
